hotel_name: La Reserve Geneve Hotel, Spa & Villa

claims.text: The hotel sits in a landscaped park of 10 acres on the shores of Lake Geneva.

findings.quote: In the heart of a beautifully landscaped park of 10 acres, on the shores of Lake Geneva

claims.text: The hotel is five kilometers from downtown Geneva.

findings.quote: five kilometers from downtown Geneva

claims.text: The hotel is 2 miles from the nearest international airport.

findings.quote: 2 miles from the nearest international airport

claims.text: The hotel's restaurant Tse Fung serves Cantonese cuisine.

findings.quote: The Tsé Fung restaurant, the only Michelin-starred Chinese establishment in Switzerland, offers fresh and subtle takes on great classics alongside the finest Cantonese cuisine.
the main act being the Cantonese, Michelin-starred Tsé Fung

claims.text: Cafe Lauren is set at the heart of the Spa Nescens.

findings.quote: Set at the heart of Spa Nescens, the Café Lauren

claims.text: The hotel has outdoor and indoor swimming pools, a Kid's Club and sports facilities.

findings.quote: outdoor and indoor swimming pools, Kid’s Club, sports facilities

claims.text: The spa's fitness and relaxation area includes swimming pools, a fitness center, sauna, hammam and tennis courts.

findings.quote: The fitness and relaxation areas (swimming pools, fitness center, sauna, hammam, tennis courts)

claims.text: Spa services are provided by a team of therapists, coaches and medical specialists in preventive, anti-aging and aesthetic medicine.

findings.quote: Services are provided by a multi-disciplinary team of therapists, coaches and medical specialists with expertise in the realms of preventive and anti-aging medicine, as well as aesthetic medicine.

claims.text: The spa offers a Rossano Ferretti Hair Spa.

findings.quote: Rossano Ferretti Hair Spa

claims.text: The hotel offers a villa, the Villa du Lac.

findings.quote: Villa du Lac

claims.text: Children can use an elaborate wooden playground.

findings.quote: Children can tear through the elaborate wooden playground

claims.text: The hotel has vintage motorboats for waterborne outings.

findings.quote: embark on waterborne adventures aboard one of La Reserve’s vintage motorboats

claims.text: Interiors follow an Old-World Africa theme, with gold, walnut and berry shades, glowing lanterns and dark polished floors reminiscent of Africa's luxury lodges.

findings.quote: Interiors seize curiously but victoriously on an Old-World Africa theme, with gold, walnut, and berry shades; glowing lanterns; and dark polished floors reminiscent of the continent’s luxury lodges.

claims.text: The Spa Nescens combines treatments, nutrition and physical activity.

findings.quote: Spa Nescens offers you unique synergies between treatments, nutrition and physical activity

claims.text: Guests can take a motoscafo boat ride between Geneva city center and the hotel.

findings.quote: Enjoy an exclusive motoscafo ride between Geneva city center and La Réserve Genève.

claims.text: Rooms look over the gardens or the lake, and most have their own large terrace or balcony.

findings.quote: Rooms either gaze down upon the topiary-trimmed gardens or out over the lake, most with their own large terraces or balconies.

claims.text: The Spa Nescens appears in the Vogue Global Spa Guide 2026 and received a Falstaff Spa Guide Award 2026 with 97 points.

findings.quote: VOGUE GLOBAL SPA GUIDE 2026 & FALSTAFF SPA GUIDE AWARD 2026 \| 97 POINTS

claims.text: Admission to the spa is for guests aged 14 and over, and from June 1 to September 30 the indoor pool is reserved for adults and children aged 14 and over.

findings.quote: Admission to the spa is for clients aged 14 and over
From June 1 to September 30: the indoor pool is reserved for adults and children aged 14 and over.

claims.text: Pets are not allowed in the spa, the outdoor pool and the surrounding area.

findings.quote: Pets are not allowed in the Spa Nescens, outdoor pool and surrounding area.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive positioning.
